verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. incorporation, notarization and trade-registration pages) and an llms.txt. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer, a 'try it' console or runnable examples, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger spec path returned 404. A static endpoint reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
